rows.note: Use this as the usual noun for someone receiving instruction, especially in a class or course.

example.english: This student is a new learner at our evening school.
example.traditional: 呢個學生係我哋夜校嘅新同學。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hok6 saang1 hai6 ngo5 dei6 je6 haau6 ge3 san1 tung4 hok6

rows.note: Use this all-purpose spoken description when you want to stress that the person is currently learning.

example.english: I’m not an expert; I’m just a learner.
example.traditional: 我唔係專家，我只係學緊嘢嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 zyun1 gaa1 ngo5 zi2 hai6 hok6 gan2 je5 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this for a learner who is at the beginner stage rather than an experienced learner.

example.english: This course is great for a learner at the beginner level.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fo3 cing4 hou2 ngaam1 co1 hok6 ze2

rows.note: Use this formal or written noun for a person engaged in learning when the context is not specifically a class.

example.english: This material is designed for a language learner.
example.traditional: 本教材專為語言學習者而設。
example.jyutping: bun2 gaau3 coi4 zyun1 wai4 jyu5 jin4 hok6 zaap6 ze2 ji4 cit3
